# Unit RTC (U126) reference-redrawn artwork

Updated 2026-10-26. Front and rear product labels. The exact SKU has no matching supplied original in the local source lookup; this update follows the user's authorization to redraw clearly readable official product photographs. Each print is explicitly `reference-redraw`.

Readable copy reproduced: RTC, Built-in battery, RTC8563, PORT. A. I2C, SCL / SDA / 5V / GND, Front icon: BUILT-IN / BATTERY. Text, color blocks and visible symbols are independently reconstructed as high-resolution final PNGs. No product-photo pixels, crops or transformed photo patches are used. The reference photographs establish content and appearance, not manufacturing tolerances. Font shapes, exact color and icon curves remain reconstruction estimates.

- [Official photograph](https://static-cdn.m5stack.com/resource/docs/products/unit/UNIT%20RTC/img-71b289e0-e14a-4a18-8745-a8a3c380d61d.webp) — SHA-256 `6b0fd9c2e13822b1713337d95d5820c051a1f828bbde8d2ef228657f913f2fe8`.
- [Official photograph](https://static-cdn.m5stack.com/resource/docs/products/unit/UNIT%20RTC/img-4924d29a-8a3c-431c-9148-2a4b220a6375.webp) — SHA-256 `4b1ecb11d30b1eb94c5ba8429512739ce92386ced4d2c8b89d1873dc501e97d6`.

Only approved final PNGs and physical-surface registration code are public. Source table, source links from that table, private mappings, vector redraws, generators and intermediate files remain private. Final image permission does not transfer artwork ownership; project code and official CAD keep their existing MIT notices.

`artwork:false` removes every label. Prints project onto existing native surface triangles, preserving openings. No film bridge or new physical closing surface was added. [sticker-check.json](./sticker-check.json) proves exact pre-edit equality of every nonprinted buffer/index/normal/material/world transform/component/port and checks four-wire Grove attachment, pose, detachment and disposal. Screen/optical/ventilation boundaries are checked where applicable. The original model's functional visual API is unchanged.

Remaining boundaries:

- Packaging artwork is outside the device model.
- Fonts, colors and icon curves are visual reference reconstructions; not the original manufacturing artwork.
- No browser or exhaustive face inspection; 3D placement remains an unverified visual registration.
